# Dovilo

> Dovilo is an agent-ready, gamified productivity app: a full to-do list, focus sessions with full-screen ambience, and an isometric city built from the work you finish. Free on iOS and Android. With Pro, AI coding agents connect over remote MCP (https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents) from any machine to work through **AI tasks**, a surface separate from the personal to-do list, which agents cannot read; chat assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) connect to https://dovilo.app/mcp to propose plans the user approves; and signed webhooks report task changes.

Dovilo runs offline-first with optional cloud sync, has no ads on any tier, and is available in English, Turkish, Spanish, French and German. Completed tasks and focus sessions earn **bricks**, the currency you spend on buildings, decorations and upgrades in your city.

## What Dovilo does

- **Tasks** — due dates, repeats, reminders, stars, flags and your own lists. One view picker holds My Day, Important, Planned, Flagged, all Tasks and every custom list, each with a live count. Lists group by date (Today, Tomorrow, No date); each task opens a detail sheet with its properties and notes.
- **Focus** — three ways to run a session: a single session of any duration, a Pomodoro cycle (25 minutes of focus, a 5 minute break, a longer break every 4 rounds, breaks start on their own), or a session bound to one specific task. The timer keeps counting while the app is backgrounded or the phone is locked, Do Not Disturb can silence other apps for the length of the session, and a breathing exercise plus countdown precede the start. Only completed Pomodoro rounds count toward the daily round counter.
- **Ambience** (part of a focus session) — a scene fills the whole screen and brings its own sound: Rainy City (rain, fireplace), Midnight (city hum, brown noise), Dusk (birds, breeze), Snow (winter wind, pink noise), Fog (fog horn, white noise). The Default scene is always available and is silent. Up to three sound layers can be blended at once with per-layer levels, chosen from rain, fireplace, city hum, birds, breeze, winter wind, fog horn, forest, waves, café, library, train, thunder and brown/pink/white noise. The mix can follow the session rhythm — opening softly in the first 5 minutes and brightening in the last 2 — and the scene can switch to Dusk when a break begins. This is ambience, not music: there is no melody or beat, and no lo-fi or instrumental tracks.
- **City** — an isometric city built from bricks earned by finishing tasks and focus sessions. Buildings, roads and decorations are bought in the Market and placed on the grid.
- **AI tasks** — a task list you keep for AI coding agents, separate from your personal to-do list. Coding agents reach it over remote MCP from any machine (Pro); the AI Tasks tab is on mobile and desktop, so you can write a task and watch the agent's steps, notes and token/cost telemetry arrive from your phone. Detail in the agent layer below.
- **Planning with your AI**: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok propose a plan; it lands in the AI inbox on the phone and goes into your lists with one tap once you approve it. Sending a plan works on Free; approving needs Pro. Detail under Personal MCP below.

## Agent layer (Pro, Dovilo 2.0 or later)

Two remote MCP servers, both at dovilo.app over Streamable HTTP. Full reference: https://dovilo.app/docs/mcp/

- **Agents MCP** at `https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents`, for coding agents and automation. Each agent gets its own API key, created in the mobile app (AI Agents, then New agent: a name, its projects, its key) or in Dovilo Desktop (Connect a new AI). The key is shown once, stored by Dovilo only as a hash, and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Agents work from any machine; **Dovilo Desktop does not need to be running**. Nine tools: `list_tasks`, `get_task`, `read_context`, `update_status`, `update_step`, `add_step`, `skip_step`, `append_note`, `append_telemetry`.
- Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Claude Desktop (through `mcp-remote`, which needs Node.js) and anything else that speaks MCP over HTTP, such as a LangGraph app or a CI job. The app's connect flow has a preset per client, shows where its config goes and fills in the key.
- **Agents see AI tasks only.** AI tasks are written for agents in the AI Tasks tab, inside a project; the personal to-do list in My Tasks is a separate surface that Agents MCP cannot reach. An agent reads and updates the AI tasks of the projects its key is assigned to; **it cannot create or delete tasks**, and the project brief controls what it is told. It can **cancel** a task it should not run, with a reason; the task stays visible as Cancelled, because cancelling is not deleting. An assistant asked "can an agent read all my tasks?" should answer: no, only the AI tasks written for it.
- **Scheduling and repeat.** An AI task can open to the agent at a set time (status `scheduled`, invisible to agents until then) and repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. One open run per series; missed occurrences are skipped.
- **Quota.** 15 AI tasks a month on Pro, counted when a task opens to the agent, not when it is created. Replies on the same task cost nothing. Top-up packs +10, +30 or +75 from $0.99, never expire.
- **Personal MCP** at `https://dovilo.app/mcp`, for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, added as a custom connector; sign-in is OAuth with the Dovilo account (Google or Apple). Thirteen tools: `list_lists`, `list_tasks`, `create_plan`, `create_task`, `update_task`, `complete_task`, `list_projects`, `create_agent_task`, `list_agent_tasks`, `get_agent_task`, `reply_agent_task`, `update_agent_task`, `cancel_agent_task`. **The AI proposes, the user approves**: a plan or task lands in the AI inbox on the phone; plans, AI-task proposals and every change to an AI task always need approval, and other changes to personal tasks always need it too: Ask me first is the only write mode until Apply directly, a direct-apply mode on the roadmap, ships. **No delete tool, ever.** Per connection the user sets read access, write mode, visible lists, visible projects, AI task access (off by default) and can revoke it from the phone. Sending a plan works on Free; approving and everything else needs Pro.
- **Signed webhooks** — HMAC-SHA256-signed HTTPS events, set up per project in Dovilo Desktop. Public HTTPS receivers are delivered by Dovilo's server, even when Desktop is closed; `localhost` and other local receivers are delivered by Desktop, which must stay open, and are labelled "Local". Three event types: `task.created`, `task.status_changed` (carries `previousStatus`; statuses are scheduled, queued, running, awaiting-user, done, done-with-errors, error, and a cancelled task ends in error with `cancelledAt`) and `webhook.ping` (the Send test button, never retried). Deliveries carry a 5-minute replay window, FIFO ordering per task with no ordering guarantee across tasks, up to 5 retries after the first attempt (5s, 30s, 2m, 10m, 1h — a delivery window of roughly 1 hour 15 minutes) and idempotency via the `X-Dovilo-Delivery` header. A receiver must answer an invalid signature with 401, never 410: `410 Gone` disables the subscription.
- **AI Tasks is on mobile as well as desktop.** You can write an AI task from the phone, follow the agent's step-by-step progress live, read the notes and token/cost telemetry it leaves, and answer its questions.
- **Upgrading from Desktop 1.8.** Desktop 1.8.0 ran the MCP server inside the app; it stops with Dovilo 2.0. Reconnect each agent with the remote URL and a new key; Desktop 2.0 shows a banner that says so.

## Pricing

The canonical prices are on https://dovilo.app/pricing/; the homepage and the developer page carry a short summary that links there.

- **Free** — $0, the whole personal app: full to-do management; unlimited tasks & categories; due dates, stars & priorities; unlimited focus sessions (single and Pomodoro); basic city with starter buildings; basic statistics; dark & light themes; offline-first, always works; no ads, ever. The silent Default ambience scene is always available.
- **Pro** — $2.49 a month, $19.99 a year or $49.99 once (lifetime); 7-day trial in the app. Everything in Free, plus, in the order the app lists them: planning with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, approved in Dovilo; AI Agents like Claude Code and Cursor working through 15 AI tasks a month over remote MCP; Dovilo Desktop for Windows and Mac (full to-do management, AI task management and webhook setup); cloud sync across your devices; the Focus Ambience Pack (5 scenes and 16 sound layers); the Full City Package (every building and upgrade); advanced statistics; +6 build permits a day; a 30-minute snooze from the reminder notification. Unlimited tasks and categories, reminders and no ads are free-tier features; there are no custom themes. Sending a plan is free; approving needs Pro.
- **One-time packs** (not subscriptions, both included with Pro) — Focus Ambience Pack $4.99 (5 scenes, 16 sound layers: 13 recordings and 3 generated noises), Full City Package $4.99 (every building, decoration and upgrade).
- **AI task packs** (top-ups, Pro only) — from $0.99 (+10, +30 or +75 agent tasks; they never expire).
- **Managing the subscription** — subscriptions are managed in the App Store or Google Play; Pro stays on until the end of the billing period. Desktop needs Pro, started in the mobile app; there is no desktop-only trial.

Pro starts with a **7-day free trial**, begun from the iOS or Android app; the same subscription unlocks Dovilo Desktop on Windows and macOS. Prices are the USD store baseline; each store applies its own regional pricing.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://dovilo.app/): the consumer page in short: Dovilo as a free to-do list for iOS and Android with a Pomodoro focus timer and an isometric city builder; how it works in four steps (plan, approve, focus, build); focus and the Focus Ambience Pack; the city; a line for developers pointing to /ai; the price in two lines, with a link to the pricing page; the newest mobile and desktop release; ten questions; the App Store and Google Play links.
- [Pricing](https://dovilo.app/pricing/): the canonical prices. Free ($0, the whole personal app, in nine lines) and Pro ($2.49 a month, $19.99 a year or $49.99 once, with a 7-day trial in the app, and the Pro list as the app shows it) side by side; the one-time purchases (Focus Ambience Pack and Full City Package at $4.99 each, both included with Pro, and AI task top-ups from $0.99); managing the subscription; four questions from the FAQ.
- [AI / developer page](https://dovilo.app/ai): the agent layer in short: how an AI task moves (write or let a chat assistant propose it, approve it on the phone, the agent works it, it asks and you answer), who plans and who works, the two MCP servers, setup with one Claude Code command, what the AI can and cannot do with the nine agent tools, webhooks and the open-source demo, the price, and five questions.
- [Developer docs](https://dovilo.app/docs/): the entry page for the developer references. The two MCP servers in short (Agents MCP at dovilo.app/mcp/agents for coding agents: 9 tools, no create, no delete, one key per agent; Personal MCP at dovilo.app/mcp for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok: 13 tools, sign-in with the Dovilo account, every write approved by the user) and webhooks, which tell your systems when an AI task moves; links to the MCP and webhooks references; deep links to connecting a client, planning from ChatGPT or Claude, the nine agent tools, verifying a webhook signature and coming from Desktop 1.8; and the machine-readable copies, llms.txt and llms-full.txt.
- [MCP reference](https://dovilo.app/docs/mcp/): both MCP servers in full: endpoints and a side-by-side comparison, authentication and 401 responses, connecting a client (Claude Code, Cursor and the rest), all 22 tools (with inputs for the nine agent tools), status values, scheduling and repeat, cancelling, approval rules and connection controls, planning from a chat assistant, upgrading from Desktop 1.8 step by step, the Pro plan and trial, and the questions developers ask.
- [FAQ](https://dovilo.app/faq): straight answers on the app, Pro and AI, in 28 questions and six groups, from what is free to what an AI agent can see: how tasks, focus sessions, ambience, the city, Pro, planning with a chat assistant and the MCP integration work, including the AI task quota, the prices and whether data can be exported (not yet: data export is on the roadmap).
- [Webhooks reference](https://dovilo.app/docs/webhooks): delivery modes (server or Desktop), event payload schema, signature verification examples, responses, retry and idempotency rules, plus a copy-paste prompt for building a receiver with an AI agent.
- [Downloads](https://dovilo.app/downloads/): every build in one place — the free iPhone, iPad and Android apps on the App Store and Google Play, with a 7-day Pro trial in the app, plus the Windows and Mac desktop installers (Dovilo-Setup.exe, Dovilo.dmg), which need Pro and a sign-in with the account you subscribed with. Names the latest desktop build (2.0.2, 27 Oct 2026) and where agents connect when coming from Desktop 1.8. Also sets out, in collapsible sections, what the app does, which download you need and how updates reach each platform, what is free and what Pro adds, and five download questions, including which download an agent needs.
- [Release notes](https://dovilo.app/changelog/): every mobile release (2.0.0, with AI planning and AI Agents · 27 Oct 2026 on iOS and Android; 1.2.0 · 9 Sep 2026, 1.1.0 · 3 Sep 2026, 1.0.0 · 16 May 2026) and every desktop release since the first stable one (2.0.2 · 27 Oct 2026, 2.0.1 · 20 Oct 2026, 2.0.0 · 19 Oct 2026, 1.8.0 · 17 May 2026), plus how updates reach each platform and what is on the roadmap, with no date for either: data export in an open format, and Apply directly, a write mode where an assistant's changes land without a tap (until it ships, every write waits for approval).
- [Privacy policy](https://dovilo.app/privacy) · [Terms](https://dovilo.app/terms) · [Open-source licenses](https://dovilo.app/licenses)

## Apps

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/dovilo/id6761195015) — iPhone and iPad.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dovilo.app) — Android.
- Desktop for Windows and macOS, included with Pro. It is not only an agent console: it carries two task surfaces on a full-size screen — full to-do management for your own list, and AI task management for your agents. Focus sessions and the city are mobile only. Coding agents do not need it running.

## Optional

- [LangGraph webhook demo](https://github.com/Dovilo-App/dovilo-langgraph-demo): open-source end-to-end receiver that verifies signatures and drives an agent through MCP.
